title: cotyledon umbilicus-veneris var. botryoides
intro: Cotyledon umbilicus-veneris var. botryoides, commonly known as 'Bottle Plant' or 'Bottleneck Plant', is a succulent plant species belonging to the Asclepiadaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cotyledon umbilicus-veneris var. botryoides involve soothing and calming the skin, as well as providing relief from minor skin irritations and burns. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
